checks.text: The page displays the heading "Period Tracker" and, with no records, shows the text "No periods recorded yet".

In the "Add period" form, typing "2023-10-01" in the field labelled "Start date" and "5" in the field labelled "Length (days)", then clicking the button "Add period", adds a list item containing "2023-10-01" and "5 days". The text "No periods recorded yet" is removed.
After adding a second period with Start date "2023-10-28" and Length "4", the summary section displays "Average cycle: 27 days" and "Next period: 2023-11-24".
Clicking the button "Delete 2023-10-01" removes the first list item. The summary updates to show "Average cycle: —" and "Next period: —".

Clicking the tab labelled "Calendar" switches the view to a month grid. The date "2023-10-01" is highlighted with the label "Period start" and the date "2023-10-28" is highlighted with the label "Period start".
In the "Calendar" view, clicking the date "2023-11-24" displays a tooltip or badge with the text "Predicted period".
Clicking the button "Export ICS" copies a string starting with "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" to the clipboard and displays the message "Calendar exported".
In the "Settings" tab, changing the value in the field labelled "Default length" from "5" to "7" and clicking "Save settings" updates the default length used for new predictions.
Reload keeps the period list: after adding a period with Start date "2023-10-01" and reloading the page, the list item containing "2023-10-01" and "5 days" is still visible.
